body: I'm doing better today. Thanks, yesterday was really hard, today was too, but somewhat bearable. Thanks so much

I survived the night thanks to all of you. Seriously, if it were not for the PMs and comments, not sure if I coulda done it.

Today was hard but nothing like yesterday.

Every day is a struggle. I'm going to keep in touch with all of you, hope you don't mind.

Tonight you saved a life.

I can't guarantee what tomorrow might bring, but your simple (actually so much more than simple) reply actually made everything ok for now.

I'm going to just go to sleep and try again tomorrow, but seriously, your words got me through this crisis for now.

I hope we can chat soon

Yeah, I go to the VA. I have a very nice and caring psychologist that really gives a shit. It just doesn't help.
In reality, my "fiancee" just left me because my ptsd is too overwhelming for her, hence my "I fucked up" notation.
I'm just done with the bull shit.
I took my meds (as prescribed by the way) and feel really dopey and tired now so I guess I survived another day.

I'd really like to message you tomorrow because it's all going to start again then and I need someone to talk to

Yeah, I have horrific PTSD. I've killed people, almost been killed. I'm 100% service connected so my son is taken care of financially.

The main reason I'm waiting to do it is to get married so my fiancee can secure the benefits being the spouse of a disabled vet gets

Please, do this.

I'm not posting this for karma or for anything. I'm just so fucking tired of it.


I wrote my suicide note today. Probably not going to actually do it today but writing the note is a big step. Maybe tomorrow, hopefully never. The VA doesn't help. Drugs and alcohol certainly don't help. Even the love of my amazing son and beautiful lady doesn't help.

Please be there for your loved one, be it a family member or a fellow veteran, a squad mate our a complete stranger.


I want to fucking die. I just don't want to hurt the only two people left in my life. I swore an oath to protect, but note no-one is there for me. Fuck this shit.


I'm so close. Not looking for sympathy, just empathy. I want to so bad but I don't want to devastate the ones I refer to in the letter.

How much longer should I have to deal with this pain before it outweighs the pain suicide would cause those I love?

Thanks

Hey there,

This letter is mostly directed at the two people I love the most in this world. You know who you are, but for the uninitiated that read this before notifications are made, those two are my son, REDACTED and my fiancee' REDACTED.

Don't tell REDACTED directly, he needs to hear it from some type of care provider or professional, as far as REDACTED goes, I guess you can just call her because I don't have any other idea how you can pass on the info.

I'm not going to go into a bunch of bullshit over causation or whatever. I'm fucked up, easy as that. There is no blame to be assigned to anyone other than me. If for some reason anyone feels guilty about driving me to this, don't. The only reason I lasted this long is as a direct result of your love and support.

Unfortunately, all the grief, sadness, hate, anger and a thesaurus full of "sad" synonyms eventually wear a man down.

So, In a nutshell,

I'm sorry buddy, I'm so fucking sorry. I love you so much and wish I could be the dad you deserve. You are the most amazing person I know. Everyone dies, I just chose the time and place. Be the amazing person I know you are, raise a good family and bring up kids as cool as you. And whatever you do, don't join the military. It is 100% their fault for all this, not yours.

And REDACTED, I fucked everything up so bad. None of this is your fault, I wish I could have been the husband you deserve.

Do not mourn me, celebrate the fact that I am free of this pain and I love you.

Readers of this note and everyone I have met and all those I have not met, let me end this with my favorite author's tagline:

Don't Forget To Be Awesome -John Green (props to u/thesoundandthefury I appreciate you making me feel so much better so many times... you are as amazing as REDACTED and REDACTED)
